# omx spring

A spring reverb: a delay, a chain of all-passes and a darkening loop, with decay, length, tension and damping.

- CLAP id: `org.openmixer.spring`
- LV2 URI: `urn:openmixer:spring`
- Parameters: 5, plus the host's bypass

## Audio ports

| Direction | Name | Role | Channels |
|---|---|---|---|
| in | in | main | 2 (stereo) |
| out | out | main | 2 (stereo) |

## Pages

A page is where a host shows a parameter. In LV2 each page is a port group, `pg:group <urn:openmixer:spring#<symbol>>`, whose `lv2:displayPriority` is the number below (a host that shows the higher first, as Zynthian does, shows the pages in port order). In CLAP each page is the module of its parameters (`clap_param_info.module`), the page labels joined by `/`.

| Page | LV2 group symbol | Priority | CLAP module | Parameters |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spring | `spring` | 1 | `Spring` | 5 |

## Parameters

Ids are the order below, 0 to 4; a parameter appended later takes the next id. The bypass's id is its own (below).

| Id | Symbol | Name | Unit | Min | Max | Default | Step or values | Flags | Page (priority) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | `decayS` | Decay | s | 0.5 | 8 | 2 | continuous, linear | automatable | Spring (1) |
| 1 | `lengthMs` | Length | ms | 20 | 60 | 35 | whole steps | automatable | Spring (1) |
| 2 | `tensionPct` | Tension | % | 0 | 100 | 50 | whole steps | automatable | Spring (1) |
| 3 | `dampHz` | Damping | Hz | 1000 | 10000 | 4000 | whole steps | automatable | Spring (1) |
| 4 | `mixPct` | Mix | % | 0 | 100 | 0 | whole steps | automatable | Spring (1) |

## Bypass

CLAP: the host's bypass, a parameter named Bypass at id 2147418112 (0x7FFF0000) in every plugin, flagged automatable, stepped and bypass; 0 is processing, 1 bypassed. The id never moves when a parameter is appended.
LV2: the port `enabled` (`lv2:designation lv2:enabled`) at index 0, 1 is processing, 0 is bypassed; the output port `latency` at index 1 reports the latency in frames. Both come before the audio and parameter ports in every plugin, so neither moves; a preset or a session names a port by its symbol.
